title: feat(nsopytmin): nsopp y-probe later-tick exist-opposite: reverse HOLD, face HOLD first at T=2
science: The only member that scans T rather than reporting one cell: reverse_T/face_T at T=0,1,2,3 on nsopp y-probes give (UNDEFINED,fail), (hold,fail), (hold,hold), (hold,hold), with smallest holding T*=2. This exhibits the band's governing law directly - S_T(q) grows with T so the verdicts can only climb UNDEFINED -> fail -> hold - and it is the only place an onset tick is measured. It also proves the T=3 global-T lists that ~20 sibling PRs report are past the onset and therefore carry no information the onset tick does not.
